experimental_design: Proteome-wide identification of sumoylation sites in heat-stressed HEK293 cells expressing 6His-SUMO2T90K
We established a workflow using 6His-SUMO2T90K expressing cells that enabled us to select for SUMO modified proteins and enrich for peptides containing diGly conjugated lysines
factor_value: Cells (~ 3 × 108) were heat stressed at 43°C for 30 minutes to enhance sumoylation
number_of_biological_replicates: We performed the SUMO2T90K protein and peptide enrichment workflow in duplicate on a lysate of HEK293 culture
number_of_samples: We performed the SUMO2T90K protein and peptide enrichment workflow in duplicate on a lysate of HEK293 culture
